question: Does the exact f696 09:29 proposal rank subsequent SOXL-over-cash H5 outcomes, and does rank quality differ across frozen good/weak Stage1-SOXX intervals after matching prior state and first year?

fixed_definitions.label: SOXL_relative_H5 minus cash_advantage_H5 on identical original Qlib H5 gross open-price plane; strictly positive means future SOXL beats cash, zero is retained as tie and omitted only from binary rank scoring.
fixed_definitions.score: f696 saved predecision soxl_weight minus cash_weight, higher predicts SOXL-over-cash; no fit, centering, threshold or sign reversal.
fixed_definitions.maturity: Use 3014 mature train labels for source prevalence only, 940 mature held labels for rank; retain all 944 f696 dates with last four unknown.
fixed_definitions.rank_metrics: Held ROC AUC and Spearman of continuous pairwise margin versus fixed score, both exact halves and all complete years; annual and quarter counts/ranks, including both partial endpoint years. No post hoc direction flip.
fixed_definitions.rolling126: For every original 819 contiguous Stage1-versus-SOXX window, score mature dates only and report AUC where both classes exist, plus low/high score conditional future positive fractions as descriptive calibration using within-window score median. Compare weak/good windows within frozen prior SOXX5/20 trend sign and first trade year cells; report unmatched 2023 cells.
fixed_definitions.interpretation: Future H5 labels overlap and are hindsight. Strong rank would require later receiver/risk attribution; weak rank would motivate a separately frozen factor information test. Neither is an economic account or trade rule.

stop: Stop on any source SHA/NAS, 3014/940 label counts, 944 f696 dates, 819 rolling windows or Qlib calendar mismatch; no new feature, threshold, model or account is selected from reused held labels.
